definitions.explanation: Describes a state of good health and vitality. Commonly used in greetings to ask how someone is doing.
Describes someone who is full of energy and vigor.

examples.japanese: お{元気|げんき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦はい→はい：09574_hai⟧、{元気|げんき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.notes: Standard response to お元気ですか

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{元気|げんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.notes: 元気がない = lacking energy/not well

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、{元気|げんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After taking the medicine, I felt better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{皆|みんな}→みんな：02972_minna⟧{元気|げんき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Everyone in my family is doing well.

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧！
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{元気|げんき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You're so energetic this early in the morning!

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{元気|げんき}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{走|はし}っています→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The dog is running around energetically.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{元気|げんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいます→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: That child is so energetic that they play in the park every day.

notes:
USAGE: {元気|げんき} covers two things English keeps apart — being in good health and having energy and spirits — and context decides which is meant. Said of someone recovering, it is health; said of a ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧ tearing around the room, it is liveliness.
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ is the medical word: it describes the state of the body, and is what a checkup reports. {元気|げんき} describes how someone seems — visibly well, cheerful, full of energy. A person can be ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ but not {元気|げんき} if they are simply low.
- As a noun it names the energy itself: {元気|げんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, {元気|げんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧.

FORMS:
- {元気|げんき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun: energetic, lively
- {元気|げんき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ / {元気|げんき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: is well (predicate)
- {元気|げんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: energetically (adverbial)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{元気|げんき}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: How have you been? Note that this is **not** a daily greeting. It asks after someone you have not seen for a while, so it pairs naturally with ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧ and sounds strange said to a colleague every morning.
- {元気|げんき}? / {元気|げんき}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧? : the casual version, between friends.
- {元気|げんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: low, out of sorts, off form
- {元気|げんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: cheer up, pull yourself together (⟦{元気|げんき}づける→元気づける：21545_genkizukeru⟧ is what you do to someone else)
- {元気|げんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: get better, recover

REGISTER: adding お makes it polite. お{元気|げんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ as a parting line means "take care of yourself" and suits a long separation rather than a see-you-tomorrow.
